source: EN.645.757 Section 7; approximating assumptions documented here
operational_scope: one request per vehicle, no ridesharing, all vehicles start at 100 percent SOC, simplified charger location and travel; no driver roster, traffic network or reliability process
dispatch_policy: oldest compatible waiting request assigned to each idle capable vehicle; accessible vehicles also serve ordinary requests
service_window: 06:00-18:00; queue remaining at 18:00 is not-picked-up-by-close; after-close events are allowed only to finish assignments, never to generate new arrivals
seeds: 1000 through 1029; identical exogenous arrival/boarding/travel random streams for each fleet within each replication
not_included: This teaching model does not establish passenger-capacity utilization, physical charger feasibility, traffic interactions, real accessibility compliance, pilot qualification, or deployment acceptance.
